meta.name: Epstein’s Shadow: Ghislaine Maxwell
meta.description: Epstein’s Shadowis a short series that investigates the powerful, connected, and mysterious Ghislaine Maxwell, who was once the heiress to the media proprietor Robert Maxwell’s fortune, but whose life takes a sordid turn after when her father dies and she meets Jeffrey Epstein, the serial sex offender. The series reveal a complicated story of power, sex, money, and corruption, which leads to Ghislaine Maxwell’s arrest, and mounds of destruction in her wake, and that of Epstein and his co-conspirators.
